text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a new year, and Narita Taishin's
challenges as
a classic year racer have
finally begun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But this year will be an important one,
and I want
to take the opportunity to
celebrate the occasion
with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I keep that determination burning in my
heart
and, once I finish decorating the
office, head out
to find Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I saw her wandering off somewhere
before
lunch!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But it doesn't look like she's back yet!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Noooo! Don't be sad! Oh, gosh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Um, um!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know! She might be taking a nap
over there!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yawn... I slept like a lo—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What the?! How long have you been
here?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
And how'd you know I was here to begin
with?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, that bonehead... She always
interrupts my
naps, and now she's
snitching about my hiding
spots?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That's it. Next time, I'm gonna kick some
sense
into her.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: So? What do you want?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Gross. Hard pass.
choice_data_list: I was thinking we could make a New...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm starving, and she won't even throw
me a bone!
But if I let this get to me, I
won't last as her
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, it'd be nice to spend
New Year's
with her, so I try to suggest
something that will
pique her interest.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Talk about coming out of left field...
choice_data_list: Let's get under the kotatsu and pl...
Let's just hold our usual meeting ...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Eh, I guess it's still better than
making a

resolution or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since Narita Taishin enjoys playing video
games, I'm able to snag her—hook, line,
and sinker. I
quickly set up the kotatsu
in my office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our gaming session gets underway,
when...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Don't just use your items randomly. You
gotta
think when the best timing is.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Your cornering's not bad, so why don't
you switch
to a car with higher speed
stats?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ew. What're you getting all emotional on
me for?
I'm only giving you advice
because I'm getting
bored!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not without a few bumps and
hurdles, but we
end up having a pretty
fun New Year's together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Absolutely not. I came here because I wanted to nap alone.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Why the heck are you asking? What, are
you
trying to police what I do on my own
time?
choice_data_list: Do you come here to nap often?
Do you take naps here often?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
But for your information, yeah, I do. I
like
napping. Sleeping lets me escape all
the annoying
stuff in the world.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: And it helps me grow tall—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I mean... nothing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A sudden gust of cold air rushes past us.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Fine. But only this once.
choice_data_list: Could you at least come nap in the...
Won't you at least come nap in the...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I watch over Narita Taishin as
she pulls a blanket over her head and
curls up like a kitten
on the sofa in my
office.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You wanna talk about training? Yeah, I
guess
that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, let's hurry to your office, then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, geez. What's with all the
decorations?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Did you do all this to celebrate New
Year's or
something?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Fine. Break out the holiday snacks.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Get a move on before I change my mind.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You expect anyone to hold a meeting
here with
the room like this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin finally gives in to the
festive mood,
and we spend a fun New
Year's together.
